$schema_note: Canonical, single-source-of-truth contract for the server -> client config sync. The HF Space proxy (`_hf_spaces_proxy/app.py`, `GET /`) EMITS these keys; the browser widget (`_static/ai-assistant.js`, `_fetchProxyDatasetInfo`) CONSUMES them. `tests/test_discovery_contract.py` fails if either side drifts from this file. This is the mechanism that keeps app.py and the JS in sync: change a key here, and both sides must be updated or CI goes red.
token_policy: The manifest NEVER carries secret values. Token slots are exposed only as presence booleans (`*_set`) and a classified type (`*_type`). Real secrets live exclusively in server env / HF repo secrets (HF_TOKEN, HF_WRITE_TOKEN, HF_DATASET_TOKEN). The client MUST NOT be a source of secrets.

consumed_fields.purpose: Auto-discovered Hugging Face dataset repo id for the training-contribution links.
Whether the server has both a dataset repo and a write token configured.
Server default for durable rating persistence (client may override per session).
Classified read/inference token class (fine-grained | read | write | unknown) for the token-posture row.
Classified write token class for the least-privilege posture indicator.
True when a distinct write token exists (writes do not reuse the read token).

server_emitted_but_not_yet_consumed.note: The manifest also exposes these for operators/future use. They are NOT part of the enforced contract yet; promote an entry into `consumed_fields` when the client starts reading it.
